done_when: A test where the interrupt lands after a completed write leaves exactly one line for that event; fails on current code; LiquidationLogWiringTest passes
goal: shutdown() interrupts the writer; a completed write can still throw ClosedByInterruptException and the one-shot retry appends the same line twice. Stop the writer with a flag plus poll timeout or a poison pill, or drop the retry and count the error. Found by the review of a95155258.
title: BinanceLiquidationAccumulator.writeLine retry after ClosedByInterruptException can append a duplicate line at shutdown
